adversarial_audit.objection: Both local fields are isometries, so the polar matched filter should accept the raw field.
adversarial_audit.resolution: False asymptotically: tensor copies drive their natural global overlap, and therefore unwhitened correct success, to zero.

adversarial_audit.objection: Near-isometry of C_J guarantees its polar works on the native state.
adversarial_audit.resolution: False without state alignment. The exact correction term is bounded by kappa R, which can be large if the raw state concentrates on bad modes.

adversarial_audit.objection: Proving physical-input domination would complete this decoder.
adversarial_audit.resolution: The direction is reversed: polynomial domination plus raw/polar separation proves decoder failure.

adversarial_audit.objection: This rejects the known constant-success physical PGM information-theoretically.
adversarial_audit.resolution: No. That PGM may use a different multiplicity whitening and is not identified with Q=polar(C_J) here.

falsifiers_triggered: The polar-completed near-isometry is not automatically matched to the native raw joint-character state.
A flat or polynomially dominated native input would prove failure, not success, for this decoder.
Any rescue must demonstrate structured raw-state concentration or use a different physical PGM.

proof_obligations.resolution: The unwhitened correct probability is at most the proved vanishing raw/polar overlap.
It can matter only through kappa R: concentration of the raw state on the Frobenius-small bad singular sector.
Bound ||C_K||^2 and, more sharply, the joint spectral alignment of C_K C_K^* with |polar(C_J)-C_J|^2 on natural portfolios.
Other multiplicity-whitened decoders remain outside scope.

summary: Converted raw/polar transform separation into an operational decoder boundary: the native unwhitened matched filter fails, and global polar whitening can rescue it only through strong raw-state concentration on the polar bad sector. Polynomial physical domination would kill the route.

theorem.correct_block: Every correct-label block of C_J^*C_K equals A=|G|^-1 sum_h J_h^*K_h.
theorem.local_cross_map: J_h^*K_h=F_h^-1/2(|M_+|+|M_-|) is a positive contraction; the k-pair cross map is its tensor product.
theorem.natural_consequence: The overlap vanishes and E R=O(|G|^-0.245...); any uniform polynomial-in-n raw concentration bound forces P_Q to vanish.
theorem.polar_distance: For Q=polar(C_J), ||Q-C_J||_F^2/(|G|D) is at most the normalized Gram Frobenius residual R.
theorem.revised_physical_gate: A flat/dominated native raw state kills this polar decoder. A rescue requires structured concentration on the polar bad singular sector.
theorem.scope: This rejects the unwhitened matched filter and conditionally rejects its global polar under raw-state domination. It does not analyze every physical PGM or prove the required concentration absent.
theorem.unwhitened_success: P_match=Tr(A^2)/D<=Tr(A)/D, exactly the normalized raw/polar overlap.
